name: Abu Kabir

queries.query: Egypt official cadastral map parcel viewer Abu Kabir Sharqia cadastral map Egyptian General Survey Authority
queries.result: First-party results identified the Egyptian General Survey Authority (ESA), its official map/product pages, the official digital-map purchase workflow, and a Sharqia district office map route. No public parcel viewer or anonymous parcel-feature API for Abu Kabir was identified.

queries.query: أبو كبير الشرقية خريطة كادسترية قطع الأراضي الهيئة المصرية العامة للمساحة
queries.result: First-party Arabic results identified ESA as the authority responsible for survey maps, property-map records, and digital map products; the official service page exposes a Sharqia district route but no public anonymous parcel geometry service. A government service listing for a land-survey statement was found, but its TLS certificate was expired during the request and verification was not bypassed.

registryBasis: The national Egyptian General Survey Authority is evidenced as the official survey/map custodian, including property-map records and digital-map production. No Abu Kabir-specific local registry, public parcel viewer, or public parcel API was evidenced; therefore registryFound remains null.

officialSources.observation: Official Arabic site describes ESA's historical role in topographic maps, property books for agricultural land and built properties, and cadastral/map services.

Official digital-map page says requests must specify location, scale, layers, output format, and projection; it describes a purchase/inspection/estimate/payment/delivery workflow rather than a public parcel API.
Official district page links the Sharqia governorate office map at https://www.esa.gov.eg/districts/%D8%B4%D8%B1%D9%82%D9%8A%D8%A9.jpeg; this is an office/contact route, not parcel geometry.

runtimeAssessment.reason: Official national custodian and map-request workflow are evidenced, but no public anonymous parcel feature response, safe native parcel identity, or parcel geometry was obtained. Research completion is not source integration, adapter admission, or runtime qualification.

pointBasis: Immutable WUP queue point retained exactly in latitude/longitude order; no coordinate adjustment was made to seek a parcel hit.
